append.detail: The housing compose/edit form submitted through a raw <button type=submit> and nothing under app/(main)/housing read a pending state, so a second tap while the geocode and governed write ran posted the same listing twice. Added app/(main)/housing/new/submit.tsx, a client leaf that reads useFormStatus() and renders the shared Button with loading={pending} (disabled and aria-busy while pending), and housing-form.tsx now renders <HousingSubmit> inside the form in place of the raw button, covering both create and edit. Pinned by app/(main)/housing/new/housing-submit.test.ts, which fails on a bare submit button returning, on the leaf losing useFormStatus(), or on the loading prop going away.
